mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and higher corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST MoM > 5% does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply-side activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO MoM < -1% does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS 3M > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 MoM signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% MoM and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% MoM, it signals a strong demand environment coupled with a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong demand and tight labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1%, or the correlation between low FEDFUNDS and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
